Step 3. Applying the analytic interpolation theorem to \(S_{01320013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the variational convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01320011 \cdot C_01320012 \cdot C_01320013\).
